name: Palm River Academy
tagline: An English language center in Hội An where children learn English by doing real things.
description: Palm River Academy is an English language center in Hội An, Việt Nam, for children from 20 months to 18 years. We teach English through content: science, maths, cooking, art and sport, in classes of 13 or fewer.
licenceLine: Palm River Academy is a licensed English language center in Hội An, Việt Nam.
